metadata.description: Two flight sims on one open-source engine (Godot 4 + Rust), for Linux, macOS and Windows: a re-implementation of Jane's IAF (1998) that runs on your own game data, and Modern IAF, a present-day Israeli Air Force sim built on open data

claudeEvidence.kind: 实际游戏源码提交的 Claude 共同署名
claudeEvidence.commitSubject: Tail numbers: each jet its own, never the player's (the Sufa, the Barak, the Adir; AI, units, parked jets)
claudeEvidence.scope: 确认作者声明或 Claude 参与；不独立验证模型生成过程，也不据此声称全游戏由 Claude 独立完成。
